config.rationale: Tests the token-count hypothesis: patch_size=2 yields 196 tokens (vs 49 at patch_size=4), giving self-attention 4x more relational structure to exploit. Retains the best transformer settings from compact_tf_d6_mean (hidden=128, depth=6, mean pooling, mlp_ratio=3). Batch size 64 stabilises attention gradients with the longer sequence. LR 4e-4 is between the two prior transformer LRs. Weight decay 0.03 (AdamW decoupled) regularises the larger attention matrices. Mean pooling aggregates all 196 tokens, preserving spatial information that cls-token pooling would discard.
